description: tools/test-projects/core-utilities (WEB_PROJECT=core-utilities tools/build.sh web): the logger's browser console sink (levels, order) and a Lua Timer in a build without pthreads. No pixel check: the scene is empty. lua/main.lua runs before the C++ init. The Performance sampler samples 3 s: the web reports no thread clock (AC14). Then culling-group-and-simulation-distance AC17 (main.cpp): the p99 of a 10,000-sphere Culling Group's and of 1,000 Simulation Culling components' evaluation over 200 frames within R22's web budgets, and the events of a scripted camera move.
